name: openmmo
description: Play OpenMMO from Claude Desktop with your own character.
long_description: Signs in with your Google account and plays one of your OpenMMO characters through game tools: look around, walk, fight, trade and talk. Monster HP stays hidden unless the character wears a stethoscope, the same as for human players.

server.description: WebSocket address of the OpenMMO server.
